description: Per-residue distance to the transplanted AMP-PNP versus metazoan ortholog conservation for the ADCK1 nucleotide-site residues
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# --- recompute the ADCK1 -> 5I35 superposition from scratch, self-contained ---
res1,_h1=parse_pdb("struct/AF-ADCK1.pdb")
res5,_h5=parse_pdb("struct/5I35.pdb")
k1,s1,ca1=chain_ca(res1,"A")
k5,s5,ca5=chain_ca(res5,"A")
pairs,R,pc,qc,tm,rmsd,ncore=tmalign(ca1,s1,ca5,s5)
print(f"AF-ADCK1 -> 5I35 : TM={tm:.3f} RMSD={rmsd:.2f} A core={ncore} aligned={len(pairs)}")

# AMP-PNP heavy atoms from 5I35 (read the file directly so we are sure what we use)
anp=[]
for ln in open("struct/5I35.pdb"):
    if ln.startswith("HETATM") and ln[17:20].strip()=="ANP" and ln[76:78].strip()!="H":
        anp.append([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
anp=np.array(anp); print("AMP-PNP heavy atoms:",len(anp))

# transform ADCK1 all-atom coords into the 5I35 frame
def tf(X): return (X-pc)@R+qc
dist={}
for key in k1:
    nm,resi=res1[key]['name'],key[1]
    X=np.array([v for v in res1[key]['atoms'].values()])
    if len(X)==0: continue
    d=np.linalg.norm(tf(X)[:,None,:]-anp[None,:,:],axis=2).min()
    dist[resi]=d

rows=[]
for lbl,pos,aa,pcons,cov,comp in cons if False else []:
    pass
cons=json.load(open("adck1_motif_conservation.json"))
VAL={102:"K276",105:"Q279",164:"A339",165:"S340",183:"K358",236:"E411",
     271:"E446",315:"D488",320:"N493",338:"D507",339:"F508",340:"G509"}
for row in cons:
    lbl,pos,aa,pc_,cov,comp=row[0],row[1],row[2],row[3],row[4],row[5]
    rows.append({"label":lbl,"pos":pos,"aa":aa,"cons_pct":pc_,
                 "dist_to_AMPPNP":round(dist.get(pos,np.nan),2),
                 "coq8a_equiv":VAL.get(pos,""),"composition":comp})
t=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pos")
t.to_csv("adck1_site_conservation_distance.csv",index=False)
print(t.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,5.2))
col=["#E45756" if r.coq8a_equiv else "#9DA7B3" for r in t.itertuples()]
sc=ax.scatter(t.dist_to_AMPPNP,t.cons_pct,c=col,s=90,edgecolor='k',linewidth=0.5,zorder=3)
for r in t.itertuples():
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{r.pos}",(r.dist_to_AMPPNP,r.cons_pct),fontsize=8,
                xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axhline(30.6,ls='--',c='#555555',lw=1)
ax.text(ax.get_xlim()[1],31.5,"background identity 30.6%",ha='right',fontsize=8,color='#555555')
ax.set_xlabel("Minimum heavy-atom distance to transplanted AMP-PNP (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("Identity across 91 metazoan ADCK1 orthologs (%)")
ax.set_title("ADCK1 nucleotide-site residues: pocket proximity vs ortholog conservation\n"
             "red = has an experimentally characterised COQ8A counterpart",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,106); ax.grid(alpha=0.25,zorder=0)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
